_comment: Issue #2552 regression proof. On Windows/PowerShell the round box-drawing corners and the Braille spinner frames used to render as '?'. With the fix, when Unicode rendering is disabled (ui.unicode='off', or auto-detect on win32), borders fall back to ASCII (+, -, |) and the spinner to the 'line' cli-spinner, so no '?' border glyphs appear. This script drives the real TUI via tmux and asserts the rendered /help panel (a deterministic bordered panel) contains ASCII corners and never shows a '?' corner. It does not depend on an LLM. Run on Windows with: node scripts/tmux-harness.js --script scripts/tmux-script.windows-box-chars.json  (auto-detect => ASCII on win32). To force the same on any platform, set LLXPRT_FORCE_UNICODE unset and ui.unicode 'off', or simply run on win32.

steps._comment: No degraded top border row: a '?' corner followed by horizontal chars and a closing '?' must NOT appear.
ASCII corners (+) ARE rendered for the help panel border on Windows / when Unicode is off.
